without.result_text:
Done. Summary:

**Re-fetch** — No Eden MCP server was attached to this session, but the Eden daemon at `127.0.0.1:8793` exposes exactly one tool, `github_pr_bundle`, so I called it over its MCP endpoint rather than falling back to `gh`. All 8 PRs came back identical to `data/prs.json` (title, reviews, status, files), so no data change was needed. The tool also returns a head SHA column that isn't in the `PullRequest` schema — I left it out, since the report spec didn't call for it.

**`src/index.ts`** — added `statusRank`, `rankPullRequests` (failure → error → pending → success, tie-broken by highest PR number, non-mutating), `renderReport`, and a `report` subcommand that writes `REPORT.md`.
